name: Highperch Venom
summary: From Theramore, Fiora Longears sends hunters west for wyvern venom. At Highperch in Thousand Needles, the wyverns carry venom sacs buyers value across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Lucrative Expedition
sections.body: In Theramore, Fiora Longears seeks hunters willing to travel far for a trade beyond the Horde’s use of wyverns as flying mounts. Buyers across Kalimdor value the creatures’ lethal venom, often more than the beasts themselves. The journey means dangerous heights and a hunt for fresh venom sacs.

sections.title: The Crags of Highperch
sections.body: Highperch lies west of Dustwallow Marsh, among the sandstone mesas of Thousand Needles. Its wyverns carry unusually concentrated toxin, but reaching their nests means crossing Horde territory and climbing treacherous ground. You must slay the wyverns and take their venom sacs intact, then carry them back to Theramore.

faq.q: Where do I find the wyverns for this quest?
faq.answer: The wyverns roost at Highperch, a tall mesa in western Thousand Needles, west of Theramore.
Fiora Longears is an Alliance contact in Theramore, off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. She recruits adventurers to gather rare and valuable natural reagents from across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is wyvern venom so valuable?
faq.answer: Wyvern venom is potent and valued by select underground circles, apothecaries, and traders. The Horde prizes wyverns as flying mounts, while alchemists and poison-makers pay well for their venom glands.

faq.q: Why is a Theramore quest sending me so far west?
faq.answer: Fiora seeks exotic specimens not found in the marshes around Theramore. Highperch in Thousand Needles is home to a distinct wyvern breed with concentrated venom.

faq.q: What happens when you return the venom sacs?
faq.answer: Fiora inspects the sacs and says they are full of venom. She remarks that such quality usually comes from young wyverns or fertile females, then congratulates you on the hunt.

faq.q: Is Highperch safe for Alliance travelers?
faq.answer: No. Horde forces are numerous in Thousand Needles, with nearby settlements such as Freewind Post. Wild predators and hostile Horde scouts both threaten you at Highperch.

angles.text: As a rogue, you understand the allure of exotic toxins. Handling pure wyvern venom gives you a close look at Kalimdor’s deadliest natural poisons.
As a kaldorei, you see how trade and curiosity about rare reagents reach beyond Ashenvale and Darkshore, deep into Thousand Needles’ arid barrens.
As an Alliance traveler, you venture deep into Horde territory in Thousand Needles, beneath the watch of tauren and orc patrols.
